name: Redirect Expire
description: Adds expiration to redirects so expired redirects are automatically removed.
project_description:
Provides the ability to set an expiration date on redirects after which they will no longer work.

 Features 
 The module adds a new base field to the redirect entity and uses it to decide whether the redirect is active. The module can be configure to delete expired redirects on cron.
